description: This file contains the implementation of the MainWearActivity class for an Android Wear application. It manages checking whether a specific phone app is installed on the connected device, and provides functionality to direct the user to install the app via Google Play Store or Apple App Store if not present. It interacts with GoogleApiClient for capability detection, updates UI elements based on app presence, and handles remote intents to open app store listings.

classes.name: MainWearActivity
classes.description: Main activity for Wear app that manages capability detection, user prompts, and navigation to install or open the phone app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components and GoogleApiClient for Wearable API.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes capability listener and disconnects the GoogleApiClient on activity pause.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Reconnects the GoogleApiClient when the activity resumes.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback when GoogleApiClient is connected; registers capability listeners and checks app presence.

methods.name: onCapabilityChanged
methods.description: Updates UI based on capability changes indicating app installation status.

methods.name: checkIfPhoneHasApp
methods.description: Queries the Capability API to check if the phone app with specific capability is installed.

methods.name: verifyNodeAndUpdateUI
methods.description: Updates the UI and visibility of buttons depending on whether the phone app node is found.

methods.name: openAppInStoreOnPhone
methods.description: Initiates remote intent to open app detail page in Play Store or App Store based on device availability.

methods.name: pickBestNodeId
methods.description: Selects the appropriate node (phone) from a set of nodes based on proximity or arbitrarily.
